title: Council-meeting upload gates all activity filing
detail: If the quarterly council meeting is not uploaded, no activities can be added for that quarter - a single missing artefact blocks 16+ downstream filings.

title: 16+ activities/year x 8 evidence artefacts = 128+ artefacts
detail: Each activity report requires 4 social links, 2 photos, 1 video and 1 document. The volume is structural and mandatory.

title: Two tracks never join: YUKTI auto-pools to ARIIA but not to NIRF
detail: The ARIIA auto-pool is one-directional and ARIIA-scoped. NIRF screens show no evidence of auto-population from YUKTI, so every recommended prototype is re-keyed for NIRF.

title: IIC and YUKTI use different credentials
detail: The portal states IIC and YUKTI logins are different - a second identity for the same coordinator.

title: IIC star-rating formula is undocumented ('Coming Soon')
detail: The official Rating and Scoring help page returns 'Coming Soon'. A product that promises to optimise the star rating is promising against an unpublished formula.

title: The mandated portal has no field to record a patent
detail: IIC's IPR/TTO Centres menu registers TTO existence and floor area only. ARIIA DCS requires per-patent fields the IIC portal does not carry.

title: Budget proposals filed in actuals fields; gap to real grants 40x
detail: The awareness-spend field can carry a proposal rather than an actual. Money fields also carry sponsor identity and purpose instead of a number.

title: Same KPI field carries two irreconcilable values in one report
detail: Measured directly from published IIC reports. Relational integrity is absent at the schema level.

title: No public API or bulk export for any mandated portal
detail: No public API, developer documentation or bulk export found for IIC, YUKTI, NIRF, AISHE or MAARG. Every integration is therefore manual or screen-scraped.

title: NIRF Innovation filed per discipline, not per institution
detail: ~11 screens per discipline. A 4-discipline university files the same startup rows 4 times.

title: Departments outside the system keep their own registers
detail: ERP vendors' own marketing states the institution carries both the software cost and the duplicate work.

title: No permissions model - mentors see everything
detail: Diagram 5 names this as pain point P3. NDA-tiered visibility is absent.

title: Prototypes reported exceed ideas reported
detail: The idea and prototype fields are not one funnel. Reported prototypes can exceed reported ideas.

title: Text in money fields ('In-progress') on filed reports
detail: Measured from published IIC reports. Numeric validation is absent at the portal schema level.
